Container.Name: LoxSuite
Container.Overview:
LoxSuite is an MQTT gateway, logging, monitoring, and backup/restore tool for Loxone Miniservers. Bundles a Mosquitto MQTT broker and a web UI in a single container - map the ports/paths below, set the required variables (especially the passwords), then open the WebUI once it's healthy.
First boot creates: the web UI admin account (ADMIN_USERNAME/ADMIN_PASSWORD), the gateway's own MQTT account (MQTT_USERNAME/MQTT_PASSWORD), and a break-glass MQTT admin account (MQTT_ADMIN_USERNAME/MQTT_ADMIN_PASSWORD) used once to bootstrap the broker's dynamic-security store.

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Web UI / HTTP port

Config.Name: MQTT Port
Config.Description: MQTT broker port - point every device/integration that publishes or subscribes directly at this

Config.Name: MQTT WebSocket Port
Config.Description: MQTT-over-WebSocket port - for browser-based MQTT clients/dashboards that can't open a raw TCP socket. Same broker, same accounts/ACLs as the plain MQTT port above

Config.Name: Loxone UDP Port
Config.Description: Port the gateway listens on for inbound Loxone Virtual UDP Output - set this same port in Loxone Config's Virtual UDP Output

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Gateway database (gateway.db) and local backups

Config.Name: Mosquitto Config
Config.Description: Mosquitto's mosquitto.conf and dynamic-security.json (users/roles/ACLs) - needs to be a real bind-mounted path, not left default, or MQTT Users/Roles management and MQTT-config backups won't work

Config.Name: Mosquitto Data
Config.Description: Mosquitto's own persistence (retained messages, subscriptions)

Config.Name: Mosquitto Log
Config.Description: Mosquitto's own log file, tailed into the Logs page

Config.Name: Device Templates
Config.Description: Common Commands device definitions (.json/.xml, one file per device) - seeded with the built-in examples on first boot; drop your own files here to add or override a device, read on container start

Config.Name: ADMIN_USERNAME
Config.Description: Web UI admin account username - created on first boot only, if no users exist yet

Config.Name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Web UI admin account password - change this from the default, then change it again from inside the app once logged in

Config.Name: SESSION_SECRET
Config.Description: Random long string, set once and never changed afterward - signs session cookies AND is the key Miniserver/MQTT/SSO/rclone secrets are encrypted with. Changing it after first boot makes those unreadable until re-entered. Generate one with e.g. openssl rand -hex 32

Config.Name: MQTT_USERNAME
Config.Description: Username for the gateway's own MQTT account, created automatically on first boot

Config.Name: MQTT_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Password for the gateway's own MQTT account

Config.Name: MQTT_ADMIN_USERNAME
Config.Description: Break-glass MQTT admin account (Mosquitto dynamic-security) - used once on first boot to bootstrap the broker; keep the password safe for manual mosquitto_ctrl access later

Config.Name: MQTT_ADMIN_PASSWORD
Config.Description: Break-glass MQTT admin account password

Config.Name: DB_PATH
Config.Description: Path to the SQLite database inside the container - leave as default unless you know why you're changing it

Config.Name: MOSQUITTO_LOG_PATH
Config.Description: Path to the Mosquitto log file inside the container

Config.Name: MOSQUITTO_CONFIG_PATH
Config.Description: Path to the Mosquitto config directory inside the container

Config.Name: DEVICE_TEMPLATES_PATH
Config.Description: Path to the device templates directory inside the container - must match the container-side value of the Device Templates mapping above

Config.Name: LOXONE_UDP_PORT
Config.Description: Must match the container-side value of the Loxone UDP Port mapping above

Config.Name: PORT
Config.Description: Port the web UI listens on inside the container - must match the container-side value of the WebUI Port mapping above
